title: 第13章 请神容易送神难第14章 大闹天下最后两块拼图
lines: 杨过终究踏上了一条前人从未走过的道路。
但杨过脸上却写满笑容。
虽然他孤身一人，但这条路上，有师兄弟，还有师父！
双方在嘉兴就此告别。
杨过北上前往后金。
现在的后金，和昔日的金国稍有区别。
原本的金国是以完颜家为皇族，只可惜当年在联蒙灭辽的过程中，险些被辽国组织的高手将血脉全部覆灭，幸亏当时金国大姓爱新觉罗家族，誓死保护，才使得完颜血脉得以流传下来。
随后，上台完颜皇族为了感激救命之恩，开始和爱新觉罗家族开始了联姻，开启了一种新的“两族同为皇族、共治天下”的新模式，史称后金政权。
也因为联姻的紧密性，基本上后续皇族都流淌着两边家族的血脉，所以不存在谁取代谁、谁替换谁的说法。
现在杨过以“前朝”遗孤身份回归，身怀不死印法和井中八法，必定可以重新搅乱后金。
另一边，江寒带着双龙朝西北方向而去。
“师父，我们这是打算回去吗？”寇仲问道。
江寒眺望远方，想到半月谈上提及一个月后张真人百岁寿诞的事情。
作为一名散修，他必须亲眼去看看。
一睹天榜张真人风采是其一，其二是这百岁寿诞上，还会发生一件大事，张五侠夫妇为维护义兄金毛狮王下落，血溅当场，张无忌成为孤儿，还中了玄冥神掌，算是童年悲惨遭遇的开始。
“不，我打算带你们去参加一场盛会。我们先回扬州稍作整理和准备，随后直接前往武当山。”
说到武当山，双龙立刻来了兴趣，也反应过来。
“师父这是要带我们去武当山，参加张真人的百岁宴？”寇仲兴奋地问道。
江寒点头，正是如此。
“没想到有生之年居然有机会见到张真人，我还没从见过活的天榜绝顶呢。”
“陵少你这说的什么话，我们的师父未来肯定会上天榜，你这不早就见过了吗，还说什么没从见过……”
“好了，有耍贫嘴的功夫，还不如多学两个字。现在杨过不在，可没人给你们讲半月谈了。等以后上了独孤峰，你俩总不能对着半月谈抓耳挠腮似看天书吧？”
江寒一句话就戳中二人软肋，干脆不再玩闹，认真抱着书本学了起来。
大师兄杨过走了，他俩再不抓紧学习，可真就看不了半月谈啦！
三人大摇大摆赶回扬州城。
江寒就发现他们一行人被盯上了。
准确来说不是江寒被盯上，而是跟在身边的双龙小子。
竹花帮的人。
估计是为了李堂主和一帮手下的死来的。
这次江寒和双龙落宿的是普通客栈。
从扬州前往武当山，需要乘船顺流而上，后转为陆路，方能抵达武当山。
这长江水道上有数千里，一路上被各国豪族和江湖势力把控，寻常山贼水盗，却根本没机会染指这门大生意。
名声最显的便是洞庭湖的怒蛟帮以及长江三峡十二连环坞水道。
都是最顶级的黑帮势力。
等从武汉转上陆路，前往武当山的路上，都是开阔官道，又经常有武当弟子下山采购和维护，也难见宵小。
content_en:
Yang Guo finally embarked on a road that no one had ever walked before.
But Yang Guo had a smile written all over his face.
Although he is alone, there are brothers and master on this road!
The two sides said goodbye in Jiaxing.
Yang Guo went north to Houjin.
The current Houjin is slightly different from the Jin Kingdom of the past.
The original Jin Kingdom regarded the Wanyan family as the royal family. Unfortunately, during the alliance with Mongolia to destroy the Liao Dynasty, the entire bloodline was almost wiped out by the masters organized by the Liao Kingdom. Fortunately, the Aixinjueluo family of the Jin Kingdom at that time protected them to the death, so that the Wanyan bloodline could be passed down.
Subsequently, the Wanyan royal family who came to power began to marry the Aixinjueluo family in order to be grateful for their life-saving grace, which opened a new model of "the two families are the same royal family and rule the world together", which is known in history as the Hou Jin regime.
Also because of the closeness of the marriage, basically all subsequent royal families have the blood of both families, so there is no saying about who replaced whom or who replaced whom.
Now that Yang Guo has returned as an orphan from the "previous dynasty", possessing the Immortal Seal and the Eight Methods of the Well, he will definitely be able to disrupt Hou Jin again.
On the other side, Jiang Han led Shuanglong towards the northwest.
"Master, are we planning to go back?" Kou Zhong asked.
Jiang Han looked into the distance and thought of the half-month talk about Zhang Zhenren's 100th birthday in one month.
As a casual cultivator, he had to see it with his own eyes.
One is to catch a glimpse of Zhang Zhenren’s grace in Tianbang, and the other is that on this 100th birthday, another major event will happen. Zhang Wuxia and his wife were trying to protect the whereabouts of their sworn brother, the Golden Retriever Lion King, and their blood splattered on the spot. Zhang Wuji became an orphan and was struck by the Xuanming Divine Palm. This was the beginning of his tragic childhood.
"No, I plan to take you to a grand event. We will go back to Yangzhou for a while to organize and prepare, and then go directly to Wudang Mountain."
Speaking of Wudang Mountain, Shuangyong immediately became interested and responded.
"Master, are you taking us to Wudang Mountain to attend Zhenren Zhang's 100th birthday party?" Kou Zhong asked excitedly.
Jiang Han nodded, that's exactly what happened.
"I never thought that I would have the opportunity to meet Master Zhang in my lifetime. I have never seen Tianbang Jueding alive before."
"Master Ling, what are you talking about? Our master will definitely be on the list of heavens in the future. Haven't you seen it a long time ago? Why don't you say you've never seen it before..."
"Well, if you are good at being a talker, you might as well learn two more words. Now that Yang Guo is gone, no one will tell you about Ban Yue Tan. When you go to Dugu Peak in the future, you two can't scratch your heads and scratch your head at Ban Yue Tan like reading a book from heaven, right?"
Jiang Han hit the weak point of the two of them with just one sentence, so he stopped playing around and started studying seriously with the book in hand.
Senior brother Yang Guo is gone. If they don't hurry up and study, they really won't be able to watch Ban Yue Tan anymore!
The three of them swaggered back to Yangzhou City.
Jiang Han discovered that their group was being targeted.
To be precise, it was not Jiang Han who was targeted, but the Shuanglong boy who was following him.
People from the Bamboo Flower Gang.
It was probably because of the death of Hall Master Li and a group of his men.
This time Jiang Han and Shuanglong stayed in an ordinary inn.
To get to Wudang Mountain from Yangzhou, you need to take a boat upstream and then turn to land to reach Wudang Mountain.
There are thousands of miles of Yangtze River waterway, and it is controlled by wealthy families and Jianghu forces from various countries along the way. Ordinary bandits and water thieves have no chance to get involved in this big business.
The most famous ones are the Nujiao Gang in Dongting Lake and the Twelve Links of Waterways in the Three Gorges of the Yangtze River.
They are all top gangster forces.
After turning to the land route from Wuhan, the road to Wudang Mountain is full of open official roads, and Wudang disciples often go down to the mountain for purchase and maintenance, so it is rare to see Xiaoxiao.
title_en: Chapter 13 It’s easy to ask God, but it’s hard to send him away Chapter 14 The last two pieces of the puzzle to make a big fuss in the world
